fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not defeat O5/O11/O16: all intersection constraints are linear, so the supplied global affine pseudodistribution may lift through walk bags, while exponentially many walk occurrences also enlarge the honest radius. The clause expander, legality convention, weights, control, and finite min-plus state space are unspecified, so the proposed L=1,2,3 test is not executable or discriminating as written.

Proposal 2 remains vulnerable to O5/O6/O16 because divided-power rows are linear and therefore preserve any affine combination of complete encodings; Prouhet and finite-difference relations provide exact moment kernels. The proposal does not specify which overlap marginals are matched, and its single-falsified-clause experiment omits the known nine-clause affine lift, DROP, control radius, and emitted CVP shell.

Proposal 3 leaves O4/O10/O11/O16 unresolved. The fixed complex with boundary map [5] supplies no growing cosystole, while the claimed Voronoi gauge is neither an emitted linear factor nor accompanied by a common-radius certificate; “exact cocycle” and the relevant chain/cochain degree are also not defined consistently.

Proposal 4 confuses a local Delaunay property with sound composition. Even if four AND graph points form an empty cell, unrestricted integral combinations of multiple gates can splice across shared ports; no composition inequality, DROP audit, or adverse-versus-legal growth law is given, and the Gram search has no normalization or coefficient bounds.

Proposal 5 does not establish its central projection claim: binary code distance does not lower-bound exact integer-kernel or Graver moves, because parity/carry and Lawrence duplicate directions can create short moves such as doubled coordinates. The code, integral matrix, OR attachment, harmful-move predicate, target, and exhaustive domain are not frozen.

Proposal 6 has no applicable uncertainty lower bound for unrestricted signed integer mixtures. With all phases and uniform weights, Plancherel makes the fingerprint a tight-frame multiple of selector l2 energy, amplifying honest and adverse vectors equally; nonuniform shared spectra still require exact cosphericity and direct G13/DROP/additive-parity audits, none of which is specified.

Proposal 7 merely relocates O4/O5: any emitted digit, transition, or embedding rows are linear, and affine combinations of complete digit-graph encodings preserve them unless a genuinely nonlinear CVP-realizable separation is proved. The algebraic norm helps only after proving a nonzero residual, while equal completeness and adverse growth beyond the per-level legal cost remain unproved.
evidence: No Generation-36 verifier, basis, factor, target, control, coefficient bound, or shell certificate is supplied. Every asserted benefit is therefore conjectural rather than experimental evidence.

Generation 13 gives an exact bounded-coefficient affine collision annihilating every compatible linear syndrome, and Generation 15 lifts it through every hierarchy level with zero residual. This directly obstructs the linear walk, moment, code, and digit mechanisms.

Generation 14 only passed one fixed pair-bag shell; Generation 28 measured adverse growth below legal growth, and Generation 32 found exactly additive zero-residual parity across coupled copies. These results refute any inference from local coverage to scalable amplification.

Generation 7 found an exact kernel annihilating all radix rows, Generation 12 found a cheaper DROP vector, and Generation 19 found an exact accepting signed splice. The proposed experiments do not comprehensively include these attacks.

Generation 31 shows that equal-radius Walsh geometry can pass one finite shell without yielding a growth law, while Generations 33–34 show that proposed geometric tags can fail exact common-radius and positive-definiteness gates before soundness is tested.
